segments.text: 3/7/81 - included the Black Demon taking part in Sgt. Slaughter's $5,000 Cobra Clutch Challenge, with Demon leaving the ring before the contest could start; Pat Patterson then interviewed Slaughter about what had just happened, with Slaughter claiming Demon was yellow and so was Patterson; Slaughter then slapped Patterson in the face, with Patterson then accepting the challenge, which was raised to $10,000 for Patterson only; Patterson escaped the hold but was then attacked by Slaughter and busted open with a wooden chair; Slaughter then put Patterson in the hold again until Dominic DeNucci, WWF Tag Team Champions Tony Garea & Rick Martel, and Gorilla Monsoon pulled Slaughter away:
a ringside interview with Mosca & Albano
match, Pat Patterson conducted a ringside interview with the Moondogs & Albano
conducted a ringside interview with Morales who stated he wanted a match with Angelo Mosca
conducted a ringside interview with Slaughter & the Wizard who claimed Pat Patterson was a coward and did not break his Cobra Clutch
4/11/81 - hosted by Vince McMahon & Pat Patterson; included Patterson conducting a ringside interview with Tony Garea & Rick Martel
4/18/81 - hosted by Vince McMahon & Pat Patterson; included McMahon conducting an interview with Sgt. Slaughter & the Grand Wizard,

6/13/81 - included Vince McMahon interviewing Andre the Giant, on crutches at ringside, where he said his cast would be coming off tomorrow and be back in the ring hopefully within a few weeks; Freddie Blassie interrupted the interview and said Andre was all washed up and finished, Andre then hit Blassie with one of the crutches but was then hit from behind with the crutch by Killer Khan:
of Killer Khan; during the segment, McGraw said he would be out 6 to 9 weeks and he wished Andre the Giant the best in making Khan pay;
he hoped to know in a couple of weeks when he could return to the ring

9/26/81 - Vince McMahon hosted the show alone, showing footage at the beginning of the show of Angelo Mosca attacking Pat Patterson last week as the reason for Patterson's absence from the broadcast, with Vince showing the dinted water pitcher that was used:

10/24/81 - hosted by Vince McMahon & Pat Patterson, who interviewed Rick Martel & Tony Garea at ringside to begin the broadcast, where they vowed to regain their Tag Team Championship they lost the previous week; featured Patterson conducting a ringside interview with Capt. Lou Albano, WWF Tag Team Champions Mr. Fuji & Mr. Saito, discussing their title victory and facing Martel & Garea again:

10/17/81 - hosted by Vince McMahon & Pat Patterson; featured McMahon interviewing Patterson at ringside discussing the recent event when he was attacked by Angelo Mosca, and also referee Dick Worley about disqualifying Mosca in the match before he attacked Patterson; Mosca interrupted the interview with Worley and shoved him to the floor and said he would take care of Patterson and do whatever he wants, wherever he wants:
